from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LiabilityItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific liability line item extracted from one company's financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the document belongs to")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written on the balance sheet (e.g., 'Total Current Liabilities', 'Total liabilities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value reported for the line item")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', or 'dollars')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this statement")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the label and amount for verification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_items: list[LiabilityItem]
